name: Release Drafter
description: Drafts your next release notes as pull requests are merged into master.

config-name.description:
If your workflow requires multiple release-drafter configs it be helpful to override the config-name.
The config should still be located inside `.github` as tha

name.description:
The name that will be used in the GitHub release that's created or updated.
This will override any `name-template` specified in your `release-drafter.yml` if de

tag.description:
The tag name to be associated with the GitHub release that's created or updated.
This will override any `tag-template` specified in your `release-drafter.yml` i

version.description:
The version to be associated with the GitHub release that's created or updated.
This will override any version calculated by the release-drafter.

publish.description: A boolean indicating whether the release being created or updated should be immediately published.

latest.description: A string indicating whether the release being created or updated should be marked as latest.

prerelease.description: A boolean indicating whether the release being created or updated is a prerelease.

prerelease-identifier.description: A string indicating an identifier (alpha, beta, rc, etc), to increment the prerelease version.

commitish.description: The object that the release should be created to point to.

header.description: A string that would be added before the template body.

footer.description: A string that would be added after the template body.

disable-releaser.description: A boolean indicating whether the releaser mode is disabled.

disable-autolabeler.description: A boolean indicating whether the autolabeler mode is disabled.
